senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (पेलयति)
To throw, to cast or send.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ली-ल्लं)
Blear-eyed.
m. (-ल्लः)
A bleared eye.
E.
पिल्ल considered as a substitute for क्लिन्न wet, &c.

r. 1st cl. (पीलति)
1 To stop, to cease to be or do.
2 To become stupid.

m. (-कः)
A tree: see पीलु.
E.
पिल to send, aff. कु, and कन् added.

f. (-का)
A female elephant.
E.
पिल्ल blear-eyed, aff. कन्; the elephant's eye being usually moist.

m. (-कः)
The large black ant.
E.
पील to stop, aff. क्वुन्.

m. (-लुः)
1 The name of a tree, applied in some places to the Careya arborea, and in others to the Salvadora persica; it is very commonly assigned also to all exotic, and unknown trees.
2 An elephant.
3 An arrow.
4 A flower.
5 The blossom of the Saccharum sara.
6 An atom.
7 An insect.
8 The metacarpus, the central part of the hand.
9 The stem of the palm tree.
E.
पील to stop, aff. कु; also with कन् added पीलुक.

f. (-र्णी)
1 A plant: see पीलु.
2 Bryonia grandis.
3 A sort of drug.
E.
पीलु the tree, and पर्ण a leaf.
